description: In early-1970s Los Angeles, Mike and Peggy Cleary raise eight unruly sons in a crowded Irish-Catholic household where money is tight, privacy is theoretical and every child is developing ambitions that do not necessarily fit their parents' plans.

s01e01.description: Lawrence returns from the seminary determined to leave the priesthood, upsetting Mike and Peggy, while Timmy secretly pursues a theatre audition and Eddie tries to hide his girlfriend from his brothers.

s01e02.description: Timmy enters a poetry contest to pay for repairs to his ventriloquist dummy and resorts to plagiarism, while Lawrence's complaints about the family diet reignite his conflict with Mike.

s01e03.description: Mike brings home a microwave that Peggy sees as an invasion of her kitchen, while Timmy and Joey undertake an increasingly ridiculous quest to glimpse a notorious television wardrobe mishap.

s01e04.description: Wendi tries to get Peggy out of the house long enough for Eddie and his brothers to clean up a disaster, only for Peggy to insist Wendi accompany her and turn the outing into a lesson of her own.

s01e05.description: Timmy takes up boxing in hopes of winning Mike's approval and must choose between pleasing his father and pursuing show business, while Lawrence asks Eddie to help him prepare for a date.

s01e06.description: Mike becomes convinced Eddie is sexually active and launches into unwanted fatherly advice, while Peggy questions how much the parents should interfere and Joey and Timmy sabotage Frank's free-yardwork scheme.

s01e07.description: Mike and Peggy briefly believe another baby may be on the way before learning Peggy has a cyst, while their sons spy on the adults and wildly misinterpret fragments of the conversation.

s01e08.description: Peggy's successful brother Tom arrives for Christmas and triggers Mike's competitive pride, while Timmy receives an unexpectedly large cash gift and Eddie realizes he has forgotten Wendi's present.

s01e09.description: Peggy ranks her sons on a refrigerator 'love list' to flush out whoever broke a light fixture, provoking guilt, rivalry and a hospital visit while Mike brings in an amateur detective.

s01e10.description: Frank secretly helps build the set for Timmy's musical, making Timmy jealous of the praise his brother receives, while Mike decides Joey's constant hustling requires a moral lesson.

s01e11.description: Wendi breaks up with Eddie over their future, leaving Mike unsure how to comfort him, while Frank sends Wendi a love letter and the brothers scramble to retrieve it before humiliation becomes permanent.

s01e12.description: Draft notices for Lawrence and Eddie force the Clearys to confront the Vietnam War directly as the brothers consider service and Mike and Peggy struggle with fear, pride and the desire to protect them.

s01e13.description: Peggy schemes to improve Timmy's hygiene just as he receives a mysterious Valentine, while Mike worries that her interference is undermining Timmy's confidence and Eddie's attempt at gallantry backfires.

s01e14.description: Mike and Peggy are stunned when Father Dunne leaves the priesthood for a relationship, then struggle with his replacement while Frank desperately searches for church keys entrusted to him.

s01e15.description: Peggy's skill at recycling birthday candles develops into an unexpected business opportunity, unsettling Mike, while Timmy spends his birthday trying to get onto a television variety show.

s01e16.description: Peggy realizes Wendi has been left alone after her parents separate and fears the house has become an unsupervised refuge for her and Eddie, while Joey enters a cockroach race and Timmy pursues a telethon.

s01e17.description: Timmy tries to force his way onto The Partridge Family after a contest goes silent, while Peggy's driving-test anxiety leads her toward increasingly dubious shortcuts to getting a license.

s01e18.description: After a grocery-store mishap, Peggy leaves home without explaining why, sending Mike and the boys into competing theories about who drove her away and where she has gone.

s01e19.description: Peggy pushes William toward the church choir when he questions his faith, Timmy spots another chance to appear on television, and Eddie and Joey repeatedly miss opportunities to obtain Led Zeppelin tickets.

s01e20.description: Peggy discovers Timmy has taken up an embarrassing new pastime and insists Mike handle the conversation, while Frank becomes determined to catch Joey in one of his habitual lies.

s01e21.description: Peggy turns Mike's workplace recognition into a competition with another family, while Joey manages Timmy's magic act at a carnival and Eddie tries to prove the games are rigged.

s01e22.description: Falling church donations threaten a nursing home important to Peggy, putting her and Mike at odds with Father Abdi over fundraising while Joey finds a profitable use for a friend's pet snake.

s01e23.description: Peggy resists Lawrence's plan to move out with a girlfriend he has kept secret, while Mike welcomes the prospect and Timmy discovers Joey has borrowed his beloved ventriloquist dummy without permission.
